stdout:
I now have all the information needed.

**Director:** Hayao Miyazaki, who won the Best Director Award at the 33rd Japan Academy Prize for **"Ponyo"** (崖の上のポニョ, *Gake no Ue no Ponyo*, 2008). Ponyo briefly became the highest-grossing film in Japan, surpassing *The Godfather*.

**Running times:**

| Film | Runtime |
|------|---------|
| The Godfather (1972) | 175 minutes |
| Ponyo (2008) | 101 minutes |

**Answer:** **The Godfather** is longer than Ponyo by **74 minutes** (175 − 101 = 74).

- [Ponyo - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ponyo)
- [The Godfather - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Godfather)
